title: Can you deceive the AI?
author: jeffyclassify
selftext:
![video](jvfvr3gm24wh1 "Can AI read your mind?")

  
This AI boss is always one step ahead predicting your next move. Can you defeat the AI, or will you let it read your mind?

[https://jeffyclassify.com/blog/mind-reader/](https://jeffyclassify.com/blog/mind-reader/)

This in-browser game includes a smart AI that is always learning from the user to predict their next move. The user's goal is to try to outsmart the AI so that it makes the wrong guess

There's 7 different game modes with different bosses and scores. Enjoy and have fun!

  
Any feedback on how to make it more fun/engaging or adding some depth would be great. Thank you
